title: Frequency counting
contract: Count every distinct integer, retaining first-seen key order. Empty input produces an empty map.
reasoning: Repeated scans count a candidate correctly, but revisit the same input for each distinct value.
A map stores work already done: after processing i values, each bucket equals its count in that prefix.
Increment the current bucket once. LinkedHashMap preserves encounter order; an array of counters works only for a bounded value domain.
complexity: O(n) expected, O(d) space; d distinct values
